messages:
sam: Ping — AcmeHealth reports their quantized route (4-bit + calibration) is ~30–40% slower on p95 vs our FP16 variant. They repro'd on a dedicated pool.
maya_cs: saw that. attaching logs and example prompt. CS asked for ETA.
maya_cs: ```
req_id=acme-2384 model=rlm-4bit calib=enabled pool=ded-nyc p95=312ms fp16_p95=220ms
kernel_log: KERNEL_SELECT model=rlm type=quant calib_scale_mismatch -> selected=int8_generic latency_mult=1.18
kv_cache: hit_rate=12% (baseline 85%) batch_sizes=[1,1,2,1,3]
```
ali_runtime: hmm kernel select falling back to int8_generic due to scale mismatch. curious why calibration would change runtime path. can you share model version + quant table?
maya_cs: model v3.2.1, quant_table sha=9f3b
ali_runtime: thx. initial theory: calibration changed per-layer scale arrays which triggered a kernel guard that forces a generic path. also batcher is emitting many tiny batches — overhead adds up for quant kernels.
ali_runtime: perf snapshot: per_token_ms fp16=0.95 4bit=1.38 (worst on short prompt shapes)
jin_oncall: can we repro locally on a dedicated node? cc perf-bot for profiling.
perf-bot: auto-profile run started -> job=pf-1798800123 nodes=ded-nyc-2 duration=90s
perf-bot: summary: kernel int8_generic used 62% of calls for this workload; avg batch_size=1.7; kv_miss_rate 88%; cpu fallback calls 3.2% -> increased latency.
ali_runtime: kv miss rate that high explains p95 spike. calibration affects prefix key encoding? maybe calibration added op that breaks prefix dedupe so KV cache keys differ.
ali_runtime: quick repro: run with env OVERRIDE_KERNEL=fp16_fused and batching_window_ms=25 gave fp16-like p95 in local test.
sam: can we do immediate mitigations for AcmeHealth? they'd prefer rollback to FP16 for that route.
jin_oncall: propose plan:
- Canary 5% route to FP16 override for customer
- Increase batching_window_ms to 25 on the quant route to reduce tiny-batch overhead
- Warm KV cache via synthetic priming for existing sessions
- Perf team to produce kernel PR to remove the guard (longer term)
maya_cs: noted, will propose to customer: rollback to FP16 for 24h while we investigate. drafting message.
cindy_customer: thanks — FP16 rollback is fine for now, please keep us updated.
ali_runtime: I'll open ticket with kernel logs + patch branch. Patch might be risky for next 24h but we can hotfix routing.
jin_oncall: executing canary now: route=acme/production override=fp16 percent=5 --status
jin_oncall: canary succeeded (5m) no errors, p95 down to 228ms on canary.
maya_cs: shared update with customer — they acknowledged.
perf-bot: profile complete -> artifacts: s3://perfbot/runs/pf-1798800123/ ; recommend batching_window_ms=20-30 and kernel_force=fp16_fused for short-prompt workloads.
ali_runtime: filing followup: ticket=RT-5721 labels=[kernel,quant,kv-cache,batching]
sam: thanks everyone. keep thread updated. we'll track rollback end and postmortem if needed.
